name: Fam-Trastuzumab Deruxtecan-nxki (T-DXd)

source.textbook: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

biomarkers.note: HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate (trastuzumab linked to a topoisomerase-1 inhibitor payload, deruxtecan): modeled here for HER2-positive metastatic disease (IHC 3+ or ISH-amplified). The guideline also supports use in HER2-low disease (IHC 1+ or 2+/ISH-negative), which is a separate indication not modeled here. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Invasive Breast Cancer.

histology: invasive breast carcinoma (histology-agnostic; includes invasive ductal carcinoma (IDC) and invasive lobular carcinoma (ILC))

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: T-DXd is moderately-to-highly emetogenic; provide prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier (verify exact NCCN antiemesis tier).

supportiveCare: Pulmonary: monitor for interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis, a serious class toxicity; discontinue for confirmed ILD per guidance (BINV-Q 3 of 15 footnote o).
Antiemetics: provide prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.
Cardiac: evaluate LVEF before and during HER2-targeted therapy.
monitoring: pulmonary symptoms and imaging for ILD/pneumonitis

doseModificationRules.condition: any grade of confirmed interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis
doseModificationRules.text: Hold for suspected ILD; permanently discontinue for confirmed symptomatic (grade 2 or higher) ILD/pneumonitis per labeling and guideline (BINV-Q 3 of 15 footnote o). Obtain clinical review.

drugs.name: Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki (T-DXd)
drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v6.2026, BINV-Q 10 of 15. Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki 5.4 mg/kg IV day 1, every 21 days. The BREAST dose is 5.4 mg/kg (weight-based). Do NOT apply the DeVita gastric/esophagogastric value of 6.4 mg/m2 (line 99219, DESTINY-Gastric) to breast cancer. Same 5.4 mg/kg every-21-day dose is used adjuvantly for 14 cycles in high-risk residual HER2-positive disease (DESTINY-Breast11, BINV-M 7 of 10).

provenance.locator: BINV-Q 10 of 15, Fam-trastuzumab deruxtecan-nxki 5.4 mg/kg IV day 1, cycled every 21 days
